N-add08#1.zh: 你们好大的胆子，竟敢擅闯太尉府！
N-add08#1.t: You've got some nerve, barging into the Marshal's manor!

N-add08#2.zh: 我们只要林冲，把林冲放出来我们便走人。
N-add08#2.t: We only want Lin Chong. Let him out and we'll leave.

N-add08#3.zh: 哼哼！竟敢上太尉府要人，来人啊！把这群无法无天的家伙统统给我抓起来！
N-add08#3.t: Heh! Coming to the Marshal's manor to demand a man? Guards! Seize these lawless louts, every one!

N-add08#4.zh: 喔？！看样子你们早就准备好了；不过像你们这种货色就算来几百个都不够看哩！
N-add08#4.t: Oh?! Looks like you were ready for us. But trash like you couldn't stop us even by the hundreds!

N-add08#5.zh: 时间紧迫，大家要速战速决！
N-add08#5.t: Time is short. Let's finish this fast!

N-add08#7.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add08#9.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add08#10.zh: %N死亡，其余人等浴血奋战，高俅布下天罗地网，将一干好汉殊杀于府内........
N-add08#10.t: %N died. The rest fought on in blood, but Gao Qiu had spread an inescapable net, and the heroes were slaughtered inside the manor........
